'''Belos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] businessman and member of the [[Corellian Council]] during both the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==Biography==
Belos had a very opportunistic mind and was always looking to cut a better deal. When agents of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] approached the Council with their offer to join the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] amid promises of rich rewards, Belos, believing the Empire's superior military might would allow it to overwhelm the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], voted to join the winning side. But when the [[Battle of Corellia|civil uprising]] against the Sith Empire gained the support of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Belos understood that the wind was changing and offered his secret support to the Republic Command, aiding them in eliminating many Imperial strongholds, thereby saving his life from accusations of [[Treason/Legends|treason]].<ref name="TOR" />

Belos reached out to the Republic, providing them intel to help them push the Empire off Corellia, as well as orchestrating the deaths of [[Darth Acharon]], [[Darth Hadra]] and [[Darth Decimus]]. Belos also joined the heroes of the Republic in a holoconference with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] and the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Belos explained the reasons behind Corellian Council's actions and promised that, if he was allowed to stay in office, he would dedicate the rest of his term to redeeming himself. Saresh expressed hesitancy to trust him, as he could betray Corellia to the Empire again. However, a Republic hero spoke in favor of Belos, pointing out that he risked his life to help them. Thus, Saresh agreed to his request.<ref name="TOR" />
